The '''Lightning Runners''' was a group of daredevil [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who, in the early days after a [[Unidentified refugee transport|refugee transport]] from the [[Mandalorian Wars]] crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], banded together and built specialized fliers to try and navigate Makeb's skies, braving the dangerous [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and the massive electromagnetic interference in its upper levels. Though many were killed, the data gathered by their efforts helped their fellow colonists determine patterns in the interference, allowing later generations to exploit the patterns and safely transport passengers and cargo in small shuttles through the atmosphere.
